title: Weather condition graphs: temperature, barometric pressure and wind speed (vis. >10 mi)
description: Three stacked hourly weather charts under the heading "Weather conditions: Visibility > 10 Miles": temperature, dew point and normal high/low (°F/°C), barometric pressure (in Hg/hPa), and wind speed and gust (mph/km/h), each plotted from midnight through 11 p.m. The text above describes the investigators' witness follow-up regarding lights near the Estrella Mountain area, visits to the police department and Tribal Council office, and the return to the motel at 1:00 p.m., with names masked as "*****."
